entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • MAUI App .NET 10 RC2 new project bundle size is around 1 MB larger than .NET 9 #32051
  • IconOverride in Shell.BackButtonBehavior does not work. #32050
  • [CarouselViewHandler2] CurrentItem does not work when ItemSpacing is set #32048
  • set EnableMauiXamlDiagnostics to true in templates, and for all debug builds #32047
    .NET 10 SR1
  • Binding value converters yields warning with compiled bindings #32044
  • TalkBack: Default Shell title is not being read as header #32043
  • MauiXamlInflator breaks ilc compiler for NativeAOT #32049
  • Rectangle appears blurred on iOS and macOS when its bounds are changed at runtime within an AbsoluteLayout #32042
  • net 10 rc2 keyboard overlap android #32041
    .NET 10.0 GA

Closed

  • [Android] When children are removed and added with InvalidateLayout, the position of the AbsoluteLayout children is not altered. #3639
  • [XSG] Additional tests, documentation #30494
    .NET 10 SR1
  • [XSG] unify diagnostic reporting #30493
    .NET 10 SR1
  • .NET10-rc1 - XamlSourceGen - Partial method XXX.InitializeComponent()' must have an implementation part because it has accessibility modifiers. #31571
    .NET 10 SR1
  • [X] replace XmlName by a string and some hardcoded values #30919
    .NET 10 SR1
  • [XSG] fix IXmlLineInfo while converting markup nodes to element nodes #30856
    .NET 10 SR1
  • [XSG] fix line and position error reporting #30855
    .NET 10 SR1
  • [XSG] Initial work on an XAML analyzer #30854
    .NET 10 SR1
  • In light mode project name text color contrast with background color is 2.387:1, which is less than 4.5:1:A11y_.NET maui_User can get all the insights of Dashboard_TextContrast #30800
    .NET 10.0 GA
  • MAUI Blazor Hybrid + Web template can't load blazor.web.js #31923

Created

  • [release/10.0.1xx] [Android] Fixed inconsistant status bar color in Modal pages #32053
    .NET 10.0 GA
  • [XSG] enable diagnostis by default on Debug #32052
    .NET 10.0 GA
  • [release/10.0.1xx] [iOS, Catalyst] Fixed CollectionView items height appears larger in Developer Balance sample #32046
  • [iOS 26] - The MaxLength property value is not respected on an Entry control - fix #32045
    platform/ios, community ✨
  • Expose public APIs for platform registration and lifecycle access #32040
    t/housekeeping ♻︎, external-tfm
  • [XSG] Enable XSG on HostApp #32039
  • [housekeeping] Automated PR to fix formatting errors on net10.0 #32038
    t/housekeeping ♻︎, area-infrastructure

    t/bug, platform/android, p/0, .NET 10.0 GA

    platform/windows, do-not-merge, community ✨, area-controls-border, t/a11y, partner/syncfusion
  • [XSG] Perf enhancement #31877
    .NET 10 Servicing
  • Avoid autoresize to SuperLayer KVO on CALayer via Swizzle #31999

  • Fix Glide IllegalArgumentException for destroyed activities in image loading #29780
